NO_HAZARD.entry: reset, cooldown completion, or stable contact without evidence
NO_HAZARD.hysteresis: risk-on threshold is owned by locked detector

RISK.maintain: risk above hysteresis-off or minimum dwell incomplete
RISK.release: evidence persistent -> EVIDENCE_PERSISTENT; evidence clears -> COOLDOWN

EVIDENCE_PERSISTENT.maintain: persistent evidence or recovery request latched
EVIDENCE_PERSISTENT.release: controller accepts request -> RECOVERY_REQUIRED; evidence clears -> COOLDOWN

RECOVERY_REQUIRED.entry: approved controller policy accepts persistent evidence
RECOVERY_REQUIRED.release: command completion, evidence clear, or contact reset -> COOLDOWN/NO_HAZARD

COOLDOWN.maintain: 250 ms or remainder of contact episode
COOLDOWN.release: cooldown elapsed with no evidence; contact reset immediately clears
COOLDOWN.hysteresis: new risk cannot duplicate the latched reflex

common_reset_and_arbitration.contact_loss: immediate reset to NO_HAZARD and clear all latches
common_reset_and_arbitration.new_touchdown: start a new episode in NO_HAZARD; no prior evidence carries over
common_reset_and_arbitration.fall_censor: offline evaluation terminates; runtime safety supervisor is outside this proposal
common_reset_and_arbitration.duplicate_reflex: one trigger latch per contact episode; suppress retrigger through COOLDOWN
common_reset_and_arbitration.simultaneous_slip_sink: Slip is the only enabled hazard; Sink remains diagnostic until separately ready
common_reset_and_arbitration.terrain_priority: slip_risk is not suppressed by Terrain context; Terrain transition is contextual metadata

trigger_semantics.slip: slip_risk may trigger; never wait for slip_physical_active
trigger_semantics.sink: production trigger prohibited until operational-label readiness
